6156.title: macOS capture capability and consent gaps
6156.rootCauseOneLine: Both hardened-runtime signing profiles omit camera capability; built-in browser policy separately rejects video and desktop source lacks display-media selection wiring.

prReviews.topFinding: Closed proposal addresses signing inputs, not browser video consent or screen selection; contributor code was not executed.

6156.proposedFix: Review camera signing grants and explicit consent policy, then validate a signed macOS build; design display-media selection separately.
6156.caveats: Two clean checkouts reproduce signing-input omissions, not macOS TCC or capture behavior. Reproduction code and output are inline per reports repository policy. Existing config suite has an unrelated missing-libglib baseline failure. No automatic fix is eligible because remediation changes permissions and packaging.
